Ritually bound to its wielder.

The weapon gains the Thrown property, can't be knocked out of the wielder's hand, and automatically returns to the wielder when Thrown.

When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, expend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SuperiorityDie">Superiority Die</LSTag> to retaliate with a powerful strike that deals an additional [1] damage.
